      SUBJECT:         WAIVERS ID LOCAL LAW 58/87 - Existing Buildings


                                                              WINDOW - OPENING/CLOSING FORCE REQUIREMENT -
                          RS 4-6, Section 4.12.2
                       CLEAR DOOR WIDTH -
                          RS 4-6, Section 4.13.5


      Section 27-292.6 of Local Law 58 permits the Commissioner of Buildings
      to waive certain requirements of the code. The following items have been
      discussed with the Mayor's Office For the Handicapped and due to current
      building industry state of the art the following waivers to Local Law 58
      are being granted at this time:

            (1) Win!   - Opening/Closing Force Requirement - RS 4-6, Section 4.12.2.

           The construction and configuration of many existing buildings do not
      permit installation of windows which meet the maximum force requirement
      of the Building Code Accessibility Amendments of 1987 (Local Law 58/87).
      Reference Standard 4-6, Section 4.12.2 mandates that no more than 5 lbf
      be required to open or close a window located in a space which is required
      to be accessible to people with physical disabilities. The only types

      of windows currently designed and manufactured for such buildings which
      comply with all pre-existing laws typically necessitate up to 45 lbf.

           The Buildings Commissioner therefore waives under Section 27-292.6
      of Local Law 58 the aforementioned 5 lbf opening/closing requirement where
      it would otherwise be applicable. This waiver is applicable to all alterations
      filed prior to January 1, 1990.




          (2) Clear Door Widths in Multiple Dwellings - RS 4-6, Section 4.13.5

           Reference Standard 4-6, Section 4.13.5, of the Building Code Accessibility
      Amendments of 1987 (Local Law 58/87) mandates a 32 inch minimum clear opening
      measured between the face of the door and the door stop. In the case of
      door openings in existing masonry bearing walls of multiple dwellings,
      widening can be prohibitively expensive and risks are created while the
      opening is being braced and reconstructed.

           The Building Commissioner therefore waives under Section 27-292.6
      of Local Law 58/87 the requirement of RS 4-6, Section 4.13.5 for a 32 inch
      clear width for door openings where the existing opening in a bearing wall
      of a multiple dwelling provides at least a 30 inch clear door opening which
      is not otherwise being enlarged and where the requirements of RS 4-6, Section
      4.13.6 (Maneuvering Clearances at Doors) are met.
